you'd just have to register the node that's tied to the nft store, right?

You can't register a Node that is not in one of your connected wallets.  When you list on an NFT store, the NFT leaves your wallet.  If you had registered it, the registration is turned off in that case.  The Corn site scans your wallets to ensure registrations remain valid and before calculating rewards.
Ah, right.
You'd have to connect another wallet to your player account.
unless you use the same wallet that's tied to your player account that's tied to the store account.
When you list on the store, the NFT leaves your wallet and enters a smart contract.  At that point, there is no wallet you could use to register the NFT on the corn site.
ah, nice.
So any node that's listed on a site is out of the rewards pool.

This may not be true for BASE nodes.  I think when you list them on OpenSea they do not leave your wallet.  It's a different mechanism, I think.  What I described is for Nodes on Cardano.  Glad I caught that and clarified it.  I don't want to mislead anyone. (edited)
